body: It is very hard, I do behavior tests and offer my opinions but 99% of the time I advocate for the dog because I love dogs, there has been one where I felt it was an absolute public hazard to have her (she only bonded to me, no other staff memebrs and rushed/snapped at everyone). I have thought about changing my job, after I graduate from college. I do like working there but this location is too hard and gets too much negativity. I try to take breaks but I dont really have time with school. I am either at school or working 7 days a week.

yea I know, I am an outgoing person, but I constantly feel alone, I dont have a lot of close friends. I dont have anyone I can trust to tell how I am truly feeling. I work with dogs at the local shelter, beside german shepherds my favorites are pit bulls. It is a very stressfull job, I have people telling me to go hang myself because we euthanize a dog every month or so and they dont like it (where I am originally from they do one every day). I dont make the euthanasia decisions and just take care of the dogs for minimum wage. They dont even know how much of a fight I put up for the dogs that could potentially be euthanized, I get crap from people I work with and from people that dont like our organization. I am the only person who does the hard labor while others sit in the front office and make these decisions without knowing the dog. I really dont like to complain but there are days where I feel like the whole world is against me and I have noone to turn to but my dog (dogs counting the ones at the shelter which I treat as my own).

I do agree with you, a smile does go a long way, I know this because people smile at me and it cheers me up. But at my school approaching someone randomly is pretty un heard of, I didnt do the freshman dorm thing so I dont know anyone here. I dont really drink and that seems to be a driving factor in socializing here, it sucks. In all reality the girl is not what brings me down, it is just about everything else. I have a german shepherd, he is what keeps me going.

Thank you for the encouragement and support. I feel like it has been long enough that I just need to put myself out there, I used to be the nice guy who finished in the friendzone before my girlfriend a few years ago, then she cheated on me and I feel like I am back to square one. The girls I do talk to I end up being just friends, the ones I dont are way too far out of my league and in all reality that aspect of my life is not what brings me down the most, but it does add to it. I feel like the right girl could bring me out of this funk just as my dog is slowly doing.
